stem: Pinecast has a hot-key DynamoDB read pattern and wants microsecond read latency plus lower provisioned read overbuy without changing table semantics.

choices.text: Add ElastiCache for Redis and redesign all data access around a custom cache schema.
Switch the table to Standard-IA to reduce storage cost and rely on existing read latency.
Add DynamoDB Accelerator in front of the table.
Increase provisioned RCUs and keep all reads on the base table.

rationale: DynamoDB Accelerator is purpose-built for DynamoDB read acceleration and reducing read-capacity overprovisioning pressure. ElastiCache can be useful but requires different integration patterns and is not DynamoDB API-compatible in the same way. Standard-IA is a table-class cost lever, not a microsecond read accelerator. Increasing RCUs alone can raise cost without the cache-latency benefit.
